description: Returns what DwellQuote found about the property. This call waits for the lookup, which usually takes under 30 seconds; if status is still "collecting", tell the user you are still looking and call it again right away. When status is "ready", show the user the property facts and ask them to confirm or correct each one. When status is "manual", the property could not be found online: ask the user for each field. Then call submit_property_details.
name: get_property_details
title: Get property details
